prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: mypy 2>&1 | tail -40; cat pyproject.toml; git ls-files
cd src/trailhead; cat -n elevation.py pace.py report.py track.py; grep -rn "elevation\|None" plan.py cli.py geo.py | head -60; cat ../../README.md; grep -rn "None" ../../tests | head -40

python - <<'EOF'
import re
from pathlib import Path
def sub(path, old, new):
    p = Path(path); s = p.read_text(); assert s.count(old) == 1, (path, old); p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))

sub("track.py", '''    def length_km(self) -> float:
        return sum(self.leg_lengths_km())
''', '''    def length_km(self) -> float:
        return sum(self.leg_lengths_km())

    def elevations(self) -> list[float]:
        """Elevation of every point in metres, with the gaps filled in.

        A point without an elevation takes that of the nearest earlier point that
        has one or, if there is none, of the nearest later point. A track with no
        elevations at all is a `TrackError`.
        """
        first = next((p.ele for p in self.points if p.ele is not None), None)
        if first is None:
            raise TrackError("the track has no elevations")
        filled: list[float] = []
        last = first
        for point in self.points:
            if point.ele is not None:
                last = point.ele
            filled.append(last)
        return filled
''')
sub("elevation.py", "    elevations = [point.ele for point in track.points]\n", "    elevations = track.elevations()\n")
sub("elevation.py", "    for (a, b), km in zip(pairwise(track.points), track.leg_lengths_km(), strict=True):",
    "    for (a, b), km in zip(pairwise(track.elevations()), track.leg_lengths_km(), strict=True):")
sub("elevation.py", "abs(b.ele - a.ele)", "abs(b - a)")
sub("pace.py", "counted_changes([p.ele for p in track.points])", "counted_changes(track.elevations())")
sub("report.py", "gain_and_loss([point.ele for point in track.points], threshold)", "gain_and_loss(track.elevations(), threshold)")
sub("cli.py", '''    try:
        track = load_track(args.file)
    except (OSError, TrackError) as exc:
        print(f"trailhead: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    if args.command == "summary":
        print(format_summary(summarise(track, args.fitness, args.threshold)))
    else:
        for line in describe_plan(split_days(track, args.max_hours, args.fitness)):
            print(line)
    return 0
''', '''    try:
        track = load_track(args.file)
        if args.command == "summary":
            lines = [format_summary(summarise(track, args.fitness, args.threshold))]
        else:
            lines = describe_plan(split_days(track, args.max_hours, args.fitness))
    except (OSError, TrackError) as exc:
        print(f"trailhead: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    for line in lines:
        print(line)
    return 0
''')
EOF
cd ../..; mypy; ruff check; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
printf 'lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,100\n0,0.02,\n0,0.03,130\n' > $TMPDIR/a.csv; printf 'lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,\n' > $TMPDIR/b.csv
PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary $TMPDIR/a.csv; PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead plan $TMPDIR/b.csv; echo rc=$?; git status --short
